result.stdout:
ReasonAI CLI
====================================
Usage:
  reasonai --policy <file> --usage <file> [--json] [--trace]

Options:
  --policy <file>     Path to policy json file
  --usage <file>      Path to usage json file
  --json              Output evaluation result as JSON
  --trace             Enable trace output (debug mode)
  --help              Show help
  --version           Show version

Exit Codes:
  0   Success (Allow)
  21  Warning
  20  Blocked
  10  Invalid arguments
  12  Validation failed
  30  Runtime failure
